resources.string: Allow “Display over other apps” for this app, then start the overlay.
Allow “All files access” so the overlay can scan Android/data.

Important: Tuber Simulator stores Bux/Gems in a private folder Android locks on non-root phones. Restarting alone does nothing.\n\nTo actually change values you need Magisk/KernelSU root on the phone, or BlueStacks with Root ON. This overlay edits + force-stops + relaunches once root can reach the prefs file.
